import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int N = 1 << 20;
    static final int M = 21;

    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int ret = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (int) ((1L * ret * x) % mod);
            }
            x = (int) ((1L * x * x) % mod);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int n;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[][] p = new int[M][M];

    static int[][] idx = new int[2][N];
    static int[] rev = new int[N];
    static int[] matched = new int[M];
    static int[][] adj = new int[M][M];

    static void work(int[] fArr, List<Integer> l, List<Integer> r, List<Integer> subgraph, int[] idxArr) {
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : l) {
            for (int y : r) {
                edges.add(new int[]{x, y});
            }
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << edges.size()); ++mask) {
            int rate = 1;
            int newmask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rate = (int) ((1L * rate * p[edges.get(i)[0]][edges.get(i)[1]]) % mod);
                    adj[edges.get(i)[0]][edges.get(i)[1]] = 1;
                } else {
                    rate = (int) ((1L * rate * (1 - p[edges.get(i)[0]][edges.get(i)[1]])) % mod);
                    adj[edges.get(i)[0]][edges.get(i)[1]] = 0;
                }
                rate = (rate + mod) % mod;
            }

            for (int gr : subgraph) {
                List<Integer> perm = new ArrayList<>();
                List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int x : l) perm.add(x);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        indices.add(i + n);
                    }
                }

                boolean flag = false;
                Collections.sort(indices);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.size(); ++i) {
                        if (adj[perm.get(i)][indices.get(i)] == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        flag = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(indices));

                if (flag) {
                    newmask |= (1 << idxArr[gr]);
                }
            }
            fArr[newmask] = (fArr[newmask] + rate) % mod;
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> arr) {
        int i = arr.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr.get(i) >= arr.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = arr.size() - 1;
        while (arr.get(j) <= arr.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(arr, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(arr.subList(i + 1, arr.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                p[i][j + n] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j + n] = (int) ((1L * p[i][j + n] * fpow(100, mod - 2)) % mod);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(p[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int m1 = n / 2;
        int m2 = n - m1;

        int cnt = 0, cnt2 = 0;
        List<Integer> sub1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sub2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == m1) {
                idx[0][mask] = cnt++;
                sub1.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == m2) {
                idx[1][mask] = cnt2++;
                sub2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sub2.size(); ++i) {
            int mask = sub2.get(i);
            for (int bigmask = 0; bigmask < (1 << cnt2); ++bigmask) {
                if ((bigmask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    rev[bigmask] |= (1 << idx[0][((1 << n) - 1) ^ mask]);
                }
            }
        }

        List<Integer> l1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> l2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> r = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = n; i < n + n; ++i) {
            r.add(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m1; ++i) l1.add(i);
        for (int i = m1; i < n; ++i) l2.add(i);

        work(f, l1, r, sub1, idx[0]);
        work(g, l2, r, sub2, idx[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << cnt); ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f[mask] = (f[mask] + f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << cnt2); ++mask) {
            int w = (1 - f[((1 << cnt) - 1) ^ rev[mask]] + mod) % mod;
            ans = (ans + 1L * w * g[mask]) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
